a: प्रतिगम् — {c1c} P. 1 To go towards, advance. --2 To return.

m: प्रति-˚गर m. the responsive call of the Adhvaryu to the address of the Hotṛ, TS.; Br.; ĀśvŚr.

प्रति-√ गर्ज् P. -गर्जति, to roar against or in return, answer with roars, MBh.; to resist, oppose, Hariv.; Ragh.; to vie with (instr. or gen.), Kāv.
a: प्रतिगर्ज् — {c1c} P. 1 To roar at, to roar against. --2 (fig.) To resist, oppose; अयोहृदयः प्रतिगर्जतां R. 9. 9.

प्रति-˚गर्जन n. (AV.Pariś.) thundering or roaring against or in return, an answering roar.

प्रति-˚गृहीतृ w.r. for ˚ग्रहीतृ.
प्रति—गृहम् (KātyŚr.) ind. in every house.

one from whom anything may be accepted (see अ-प्रतिगृह्य).
प्रति—गिरि m. an opposite mountain, BhP.

a: प्रतिग्राहक --हिन् — a. One who receives or accepts gifts.

m: प्रति-˚ग्राहिन् mfn. id., TS.

प्रति-˚ग्राह्य m. N. of partic. Grahas, TBr., Sch.
प्रति—ग्रामम् ind. in every village, Rājat.
प्रति—ग्राम˚-समीपम् ind. near every v˚, Dharmaś.

प्रति-√ ग्रह् P. Ā. -गृह्णाति, -गृह्णीते (irreg. 2. sg. Impv. -गृह्ण, R.; aor. -अजग्रभत्, AitBr.), to take hold of, grasp, seize (in astrol. = to eclipse, obscure), AV. &c. &c.; to take (as a present or into possession), appropriate, receive, accept, RV. &c. &c. (शिरसा, ‘with the head’ i e. ‘humbly, obediently’, R.); to gain, win over, R.; to take as a wife, marry, Mn.; MBh. &c.; to take = eat, drink, RV.; VS.; TBr.; to receive (a friend or guest), RV. &c. &c.; to receive (anything agreeable as a good word or omen), R.; Kālid.; to assent to, acquiesce in, approve, MBh.; R.; (rarely) to receive (an enemy), oppose, encounter, MBh.; Ragh. : Caus. -ग्राहयति, to cause to accept, present with (2 acc.), MBh.; R.; Kālid.; to answer, reply, BhP. : Desid. -जिघृक्षति, to wish to accept, Gaut.
a: प्रतिग्रह् — {c9c} U. 1 To hold, seize, take, support; वर्षधरप्रतिगृहीतमेनं M. 4; Ms. 2. 48. --2 To take, accept, receive; ददाति प्रतिगृह्णाति Pt. 2; अमोघाः प्रतिगृह्णंतावर्ध्यानुपदमाशिषः R. 1. 44; 2. 22. --3 To receive or accept as a present. --4 To receive inimically, oppose, encounter, resist; to attack, assault; प्रतिजग्राह कालिंगस्तमस्त्रैर्गजसाधनः R. 4. 40; 12. 47. --5 To take in marriage, marry; Ms. 9. 72. --6 To obey, conform or listen to. --7 To resort to, betake oneself to. --8 To eclipse. --9 To assent to, admit. --10 To occupy, take possession of. --11 To deprive (one) of. --12 To welcome, receive. --13 To eat, drink. --Caus. 1 To cause to accept, give, present. --2 To allow to take or retain; मुष्टं प्रतिग्राहयता स्वमर्थं पात्रीकृतो दस्युरिवासि येन Ś. 5. 20.

m: प्रति-˚ग्रहीतव्य mfn. to be received, Kull.

a: प्रतिग्रहीतृ — m. 1 A receiver. --2 A husband, one who marries.
